description.value:
Duration constant

Nothing that has been done to you has ever been forgotten by the part of you that has to carry it.

You gain 1 Tally the first time each encounter that you are reduced below half your maximum Hit Points, and 1 Tally the first time each encounter that an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Tally gained this way may exceed your cap and is lost at the end of the encounter if unspent.
